notes.title: New Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Dive into the world of The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales with our brand new demo!

Etienne Quist is a writer-turned-thief with a unique ability to dive into the very pages of books. Once a celebrated writer, his creative freedom was stripped away when he was found guilty of an unspeakable crime. Now tasked by a criminal boss, Etienne must venture into mesmerizing book realms, seeking legendary artifacts to restore his creative abilities.


 Step into the living pages of book worlds as The Bookwalker.
 Explore unique worlds, each with its own mysteries to uncover.
 Embark on daring artifact heists to reclaim your creative freedom.
 Solve unconventional puzzles, wield the power of magical ink, and encounter intriguing characters whose stories hold the key to your journey.
 Face obstacles on your quest for artifacts. Be prepared to persuade, deceive, or even engage in combat.

PLAY THE NEW DEMO!

P.S. Don't forget to join us on our Discord server, where you can connect with players, and stay up to date with all things The Final Station, The Bookwalker, and our upcoming projects!

notes.title: Play The Bookwalker demo during Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it’s DO MY BEST team here. The Steam Next Fest opens its doors today, and we can’t be more excited to show you the newest demo of The Bookwalker!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432100/The_Bookwalker/ 

Watch The Bookwalker Announcement Trailer
[previewyoutube=r3aqg00KmV0;full][/previewyoutube]

What to expect from this demo
https://i.imgur.com/mEzA5o0.gif

Play a short piece of a story behind The Bookwalker – a thief with the ability to dive into book worlds to find and extract legendary artefacts for his customers. Explore one of the books about a mysterious alchemist who tried to create a Potion of Immortality. Discover the secrets of the medieval prison and find out the truth behind its origin.

https://i.imgur.com/RuUbc0t.png

You’ll also have a sneak peek of the other book set in a completely different environment. But we’ll leave this up to you to discover!

As always, please keep on sharing your feedback with us on social media or in Discord that we’ve just launched: https://discord.gg/YYKFAx4JWY 

Experience the gameplay duality
https://i.imgur.com/uFSxkyi.gif

Walk around and explore your apartment in the real world and then dive into the world of books as if they were dreams. Come back to reality anytime, and use the items you found to craft some helpful tools that you can later use once you’re back on the mission. You may also find something handy in your apartment building and take it with you on your journey. In a book, a crowbar may be just as effective against a lock as a key… 

Solve puzzles on your way to discovering the truth
https://i.imgur.com/dOISDHI.gif

Some problems you encounter will make you think outside the box, and some will require you to travel outside of this world. Take your time and look around for useful materials. Don’t forget you can always wake up at your apartment at any time and seek a solution there. It’s up to you to decide how to tackle obstacles.

Help us get to the top of the charts!
Make sure to tell all your friends about the demo and help us reach the top of the festival charts this year! 

Wishlist and follow The Bookwalker

notes.title: The Bookwalker joins tinyBuild
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It’s been a very productive summer for us here at DO MY BEST studio. We wanted to thank you for all the feedback we got from you during our playtest that is currently available on Steam. Your comments greatly help us with the development, and we really appreciate it! Today we have some exciting news to share with you.

We’re thrilled to announce that The Bookwalker will be published by tinyBuild! 

Our latest game, The Final Station, has also been published by our partners at tinyBuild, and we can’t be happier to have them on board with us for the next chapter of our journey.
During today’s tinyBuild Connect Show we’ve released a new trailer that gives you a glimpse of some of the book worlds that await you on your quest to regain your writing abilities.

[previewyoutube=r3aqg00KmV0;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve also sat down for a short interview to talk about The Bookwalker’s development process and to share some insights into how the game evolved. Watch the whole show, or jump to the 18:09 mark to go straight to the interview.

[previewyoutube=VJ9FTM0myz4;full][/previewyoutube]

We can’t wait for you to jump into our new story! We will be sharing more news soon, but meanwhile, you’re welcome to join The Bookwalker Steam Playtest and experience the game yourself. Let us know what you think of it using the feedback form at the end of your playtest! 
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432100/The_Bookwalker/
